text: Managing a team is a skill that takes time to develop. First, good communication is essential. You need to listen to your team members and share information clearly. Second, learn to delegate tasks. Trust your team and give them responsibilities that match their strengths. Third, provide regular feedback. Positive comments motivate people, while helpful advice helps them improve. Fourth, keep your team motivated by recognising their hard work and celebrating success. Finally, be ready to resolve conflicts. When disagreements happen, listen to both sides and find a fair solution. A good manager supports the team and helps everyone work well together.
